title: Welcome to {{appName}}
subtitle: Let's set up your account
features: Movies, series, anime, manga, books, games and music in one place
Progress, ratings and reviews for every title

step2Description: Choose your language, theme and rating mode
step3Description: Add your own API keys: movies use TMDB and games use IGDB. They are stored on the server only. You can skip this and configure later in Settings.
step4Title: What do you want to track?
step4Description: Select the media types you want to track. Types without a configured source stay disabled.
